# `/devices` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /devices/v1

`listDevicesV1` — List devices — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a list of devices. A caller who owns the devices can list them. Other callers need the **idn:mis-identity:read** right. A caller without that right must filter the request to devices they own, for example `owners.primaryIdentity.id eq "me"`; if any returned device is not owned by the caller, this API returns `403`. In `owners.primaryIdentity.id` and `owners.secondaryIdentity.id` filters, the value `me` resolves to the calling identity. Source sub-admins only see devices on the…

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:

  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.

### GET /devices/v1/device-counts

`getDeviceCountsV1` — Get device counts — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns tenant-wide device counts: the total number of devices, a breakdown by operating system, the average number of agents per device, and counts of devices without recent data and devices with active agents. Because the counts cover every device in the tenant, the caller needs the **idn:mis-identity:read** right. Owning devices does not grant access to this API. When Machine Identity Security is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`. When the devices API is not…

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Returns 200: devicesummary

### GET /devices/v1/{id}

`getDeviceV1` — Get device — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

This API returns a single device by its ID. A caller who owns the device can view it. Other callers need the **idn:mis-identity:read** right. The ID must be a UUID; any other value returns `400`. When no device exists for the ID, this API returns `400` for callers who hold the **idn:mis-identity:read** right and `404` for other callers. When Machine Identity Security is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `404`. When the devices API is not enabled for the tenant, this API returns `403`.

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage, idn:mis-identity:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, HELPDESK
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Device ID.
- Returns 200: device

### PATCH /devices/v1/{id}

`updateDeviceV1` — Partial update of device — **EXPERIMENTAL (header `X-SailPoint-Experimental: true`)**

Use this API to update a device using a JSON Patch payload. Patchable fields are **owners**, **description**, and **environment**. A patch that targets any other field, including the discovered device attributes, returns `400`. `owners.primary` is a single IDENTITY reference. `owners.secondary` holds either up to ten IDENTITY references or exactly one GOVERNANCE_GROUP reference, not both; any other combination returns `400`. A caller who owns the device can update it. Other callers need the…

- Scopes: idn:mis-identity:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — Device ID.
- Body (application/json-patch+json): array of jsonpatchoperation
- Returns 200: device
